'''Joreel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] and a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] for a [[Unidentified resistance group (backwater planet)|resistance group]] on an [[Unidentified backwater planet|backwater planet]]. She created her own overpowered [[repeating rifle]], but it was prone to overheating. Joreel took part in the [[mission to Sunfall Peak]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Joreel appears in the opening short story of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]]. She was also later used as a player's character in an example of gameplay given later in the book.<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
